singleSourced.context: Season 1 will include limited themed events like Halloween, 20 Years of Gears, and Thanksgibbing, before wrapping up December 1.

Season 2, called Legacy and Beyond, will kick off after that with content themed around a 20-year celebration of the franchise’s “greatest hits.” The studio also previewed the names of the remaining seasons on E-Day‘s calendar: Season 3: Infiltration, Season 4: Pendulum, and Season 5: Devotion.

singleSourced.context: It's often said "Xbox gamers don't buy games anymore" and, well, it's hard to argue otherwise when a poll reveals 50% of gamers who pass through here are waiting for E-Day to land on Game Pass.
Additionally, the premium edition and upgrade sales generated $140m before the official launch and Game Pass inclusion.
